notes.title: 🎉 It’s Update Time!
notes.content:
Vispo just got even more exciting with 10 brand-new levels added to the game!

🌍 Explore stunning new locations:

From Kayan tribe of Myanmar to the La Crema On Fallas Festival of Valencia, Spain.

From Trafalgar Square London to the Singapore Financial District,

To a Hutong Restaurant in Beijing to the enormous St Petersburg model railway exhibition.

There’s something for everyone to enjoy in this thrilling update!

Play now and dive into the new challenges that await. Happy spotting! 🕵️‍♂️

notes.title: It's major update time.
notes.content:
🎉 Get ready for a Vispo update that's bigger and better than ever! 🎉

We're thrilled to announce a major upgrade to your favorite spot-the-difference game. Brace yourself for an abundance of exciting new features and content!

🔍 More Levels: Dive into over 160 captivating levels, including the nostalgic Steamboat Willie levels that are sure to bring a smile to your face.

🏆 More Achievements: Challenge yourself to unlock a plethora of achievements as you sharpen your detective skills.

🌍 More Languages: Vispo now speaks your language! With support for 19 different languages, the fun never gets lost in translation.

🥇 Leaderboard Competition: Compete with friends and players worldwide by comparing your progress on the leaderboard. Will you rise to the top?

🔁 Replay Mode: Relive your favorite moments or give those tricky levels another shot with the new replay mode.

💡 Expert Mode: Think you've mastered every level? Think again! Test your expertise with the challenging new expert mode – only for the most discerning detectives.

Ready to embark on this thrilling adventure? Download the update now and immerse yourself in the world of Vispo, where every frame holds a delightful surprise. Happy spotting! 🕵️‍♂️🔍
